mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST w INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON w.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN BRAND b ON p.BRAND_ID = b.BRAND_ID WHERE w.USER_ID = #{userId}
AND ( p.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.CATEGORY_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.BRAND_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO WISHLIST (USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WISHLIST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
